description: Add one link to the reader's catalogue and wait 5–30 s while driftnet fetches it, follows a post to the tool it is about, files it into a folder, rates it and, with a model configured, summarises it. Use it for a link that is new to you; to redo a card that already exists use driftnet_refresh_item, and to hand in your own summary for a queued card use driftnet_enrich_item. url: tracking parameters are stripped and share-link variants are recognised, so a link already in the catalogue gets one more share and the existing item comes back instead of a duplicate; private, local and blocked addresses are refused. note: why it matters or the message it came with; it guides the folder choice and is shown as chat context, and links inside it are ignored. Without a model the item waits for an agent to read it through driftnet_lease_items.

note.description: Why it is interesting or the message it came with, up to 1000 chars

url.description: Public http(s) link exactly as shared, e.g. 'https://github.com/owner/repo'

name: driftnet_save_link
title: Save a link
